title: Landfall STP Attestation
description: Settlement Truth Protocol attestation, v1. Source of truth for the runtime shape is packages/stp/src/schema.ts (zod) — keep this file in sync with that; it exists for non-TypeScript consumers and the anchors registry. See docs/architecture/MULTICHAIN.md §3.

amount.description: Decimal string, asset units. Never a float — precision loss is not acceptable here.

evidence_tier.description: Mandatory and must match reality — never inflate a DERIVED event to read as PROVEN.

keystone_ref.description: Stellar tx hash this settlement roots to, when it touches the keystone chain.
